scenario: Time slot assertion per LTIM.5.2 — a fact with a Time-typed slot can be asserted with an integer nanosecond timestamp and matched by rules that compare Time values. Pin: assert two events with different timestamps, pump — the rule gating on timestamp ordering fires.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule newer_first:
    Event a where a.entity_id == "a"
    Event b where b.entity_id == "b" and a.fired_at > b.fired_at
->
    log info "a is newer than b"
